title: Etale morphisms become finite etale on a constructible stratification
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and let $j:U\to X$ be an etale morphism [def-weil-etale-morphism] with $U$ quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Then there exists a finite partition $X=\coprod_i X_i$ by constructible locally closed subschemes [def-weil-constructible-subset] such that each base change $U_i:=U\times_X X_i\to X_i$ is finite etale [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. The fibre products are those of [def-pc-fibre-product]. This is Stacks Project Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite).

proof.text: First suppose that $j:U\to X$ is separated. Since an etale morphism is flat, locally of finite presentation, and quasi-finite, the separated stratification theorem gives a finite partition of $X$ by constructible locally closed strata whose base changes are finite locally free. Etaleness is preserved by base change, and a finite locally free etale morphism is finite etale, so this is the required partition.

source.place: More on Morphisms, Lemma Tag 07RZ (more-morphisms-lemma-stratify-flat-fp-qf), proof and conclusion; etale properties and finite-etale conclusion

proof.text: Over an affine base $X$, choose a finite affine open covering $U=\bigcup_aU_a$, and apply the separated case to every $U_a\to X$ and every overlap $U_a\cap U_b\to X$. A common refinement of the finitely many resulting partitions, followed by refinement by affine strata, gives a finite constructible locally closed affine partition of $X$ for which all chart and overlap base changes are finite etale. The finite-cover gluing lemma then says that $V_i:=U\times_XX_i\to X_i$ is separated for every stratum.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, second paragraph, lines 12045-12050

proof.text: Apply the separated case once more to each separated etale morphism $V_i\to X_i$ from the preceding step and take a common refinement of the resulting finite partitions. Each refined base change is finite etale, and the finite common refinement remains a finite constructible locally closed partition of the affine base.

source.place: Etale Cohomology, Lemma Tag 03S9 (lemma-etale-stratified-finite), proof, second paragraph, lines 12050-12061

proof.text: For the original qcqs base $X$, choose a finite affine open covering. Perform the preceding affine construction on each member. The locality/gluing lemma assembles the finitely many local partitions into one finite constructible locally closed partition of $X$, preserving the finite-etale base-change property on every piece.
